structure.unit: Group Accident and Sickness Insurance Policies

law.catch_line: Policies issued outside of the Commonwealth of Virginia
law.text: A group accident and sickness insurance policy issued outside of this Commonwealth, providing coverage to residents of this Commonwealth, that does not qualify under § 38.2-3521.1 or § 38.2-3522.1 shall be subject to the statutory requirements of this title and may subject the insurer issuing such policy to the penalties available under this title for violation of such requirements.
